rootCause.observedBoundary: Physical input reached the shared toolbar route: Full width, Copy as image and Open full screen worked, while only Fit failed after Full width had been made explicit.
rootCause.proven: After applyPersistedLayouts adopted an explicit { fullWidth: true } entry, toggleFullWidthFromElement selected Fit and called persist(). persist() called syncIdentities(), which re-adopted the old host snapshot, re-added Full width and restored the Full width DOM before serialization. The click therefore appeared inert even though it was delivered.

regressionHistory.lastKnownGood: v2.5.2 and earlier used the v1 session-only TableResize path: a user action could not re-adopt a profile snapshot because table layout persistence did not exist.
regressionHistory.introduced: db68b065 (2026-10-19 00:42 +05, C-65) introduced profile adoption and made persist() call syncIdentities(), while syncIdentities() also applied the previously loaded snapshot. This conflated identity refresh with load-time state adoption.
regressionHistory.exposed: 3344ab1d (2026-10-19 10:59 +05) added automatic Full width and the explicit persisted Fit choice without separating those responsibilities. Its reload test adopted Fit on a fresh instance but performed the reverse toggle on the original instance, so it never exercised adopted Full width → Fit on one reopened instance.
regressionHistory.shipped: Both commits are ancestors of v2.5.3; the state rollback is therefore a v2.5.3 regression rather than a table-footer or later event-routing regression.

rootCause.whyItWorkedEarlier: The pre-C-65 session-only implementation had no saved snapshot to re-adopt. Even after C-65, automatic Full width has no persisted fullWidth entry, so the first Fit transition can work until Full width is explicitly saved and later adopted; the next Fit activation then hits the stale-snapshot rollback.
rootCause.repair: syncIdentities accepts adoptPersisted=false for user writes. persist() refreshes identities without adopting the old snapshot, serializes the current user state, replaces the local persisted snapshot with those entries, and only then dispatches muya-table-layouts. The persistence schema, table visuals and width policy are unchanged.
rootCause.failingFirst: The adopted-fullWidth unit failed before repair with 60 passed / 1 failed: isFullWidth remained true after Fit. It passes after repair in the 61/61 focused file.
rootCause.lessonLearned: Start this class of regression from the last-known-good implementation and compare the complete state lifecycle, not only event delivery. A persistence interaction test must exercise save → reopen → adopt → mutate on the reopened instance; a click-only or load-only test cannot detect stale-snapshot rollback.
